title: Four Hearts Form an Unbreakable Family — Part 6

series.summary: Rentaro introduces Nano to Hakari, Karane, and Shizuka on the school rooftop. Nano logically argues that sharing Rentaro across four girlfriends maximizes emotional efficiency and scheduling. The girls embrace their newest companion, cementing a four-way bond of boundless love.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro proudly brings Nano to the sunny rooftop garden to introduce her to his other three beloved, faithful girlfriends.
Nano casually reveals they are now officially dating, leaving Hakari, Karane, and little Shizuka completely and utterly speechless in shock.
She explains with clinical precision that a four-girlfriend harem mathematically optimizes schedule efficiency, daily chores, and shared romantic affection.
Overcoming their initial shock, all four girls immediately bond, enthusiastically planning their upcoming group dates all around the town.
Rentaro weeps tears of boundless gratitude as his expanding family unites together in complete, radiant, and harmonious love.
